references.text: God tells Abraham that he will lie down with his fathers, the same expression used for Moses' impending death
The warning against committing spiritual adultery by following foreign gods and making covenants with the inhabitants of the land
Israel committed spiritual adultery with Moab's daughters and bowed to their gods, fulfilling the warning
Joshua warns the people against breaking the covenant and serving foreign gods
Israel abandoned the Lord and served Baal and Ashtoreth, a direct fulfillment of the prophecy
After Gideon's death, Israel committed spiritual adultery by following the Baals and broke the covenant
Solomon followed foreign gods and abandoned the Lord, fulfilling the warning
The Lord accuses Israel of breaking their yoke and committing spiritual adultery on every high hill
Ezekiel describes Israel's spiritual adultery with foreign gods
Hosea describes how the land commits spiritual adultery by turning away from the Lord
Stephen quotes how God turned away from Israel because they worshiped foreign gods
